name: dev-cisco-xe-reference-16

irregularities.what: the console's own login list CONSOLE (local only, so a local user always gets in there)
the accounting session id is common
the login method of line con 0: login authentication CONSOLE (the device has: the login method of line con 0: login authentication default)
aaa server radius dynamic-author client 192.0.2.7 server-key
irregularities.statement: aaa server radius dynamic-author > client 192.0.2.7 server-key <secret>
irregularities.action: Left alone. To remove it later, type these lines in order: aaa server radius dynamic-author / no client 192.0.2.7

region: ! aaa: the method lists tacctl renders, each replaced by the rendered line (the console's own list is local only)
! aaa: the login method of the console and vty lines
after: ! If any line printed "% Invalid" or "% Error", stop and undo it: tacctl device config plan
! dev-cisco-xe-reference-16 --backout (its own region, to paste in the second terminal).
! Check now (nothing rolls this back by itself):
!   From the tacctl server:   tacctl device config pull dev-cisco-xe-reference-16 --diff     (aaa: ok)
!   In the second terminal:   open a NEW ssh session to dev-cisco-xe-reference-16 as yourself, then: terminal length 0, show privilege (must say 15)
! When both checks are fine, type this one command yourself:  write memory
! To undo: tacctl device config plan dev-cisco-xe-reference-16 --backout (tacctl keeps this plan's
! back-out: after the check pull has replaced the picture, the command still prints this plan's,
! and says which pull it undoes, until the next plan with changes)
! Do not: 'write memory' before the check; paste outside the banners; paste into another device;
! paste on a console more than twenty lines at a time; keep this output in a file after the paste
! Locked out (the paste cut your session and no login works)? A superuser runs: tacctl breakglass hold dev-cisco-xe-reference-16 --reason "..."
! then log in as the device's local account (console: local login, then 'enable' with the local secret),
! fix or back out, and the superuser runs: tacctl breakglass release dev-cisco-xe-reference-16
backout: ! back-out: the lines as the pull showed them
no aaa authentication login CONSOLE local

extras.text: aaa server radius dynamic-author > client 192.0.2.7 server-key

warnings: the device has no enable secret: with the server unreachable, level 15 is reached only through the local user and 'aaa authorization exec'; set an enable secret first if you want a second way
cleanup_deferred: cleanup comes after this region is pasted and verified: pull the device, then plan --converge again
